headline: IVE to wrap world tour with Seoul encore in January
sub: 3 nights at KSPO DOME, where the tour first began

points.title: What to know
items: The tour kicked off at KSPO DOME in Oct 2025
IVE played Tokyo Dome and Kyocera Dome Osaka
North America grew from 6 to 8 cities

source: Source: Official announcement from Starship Entertainment
caption:
IVE will close out their 2nd world tour with an encore concert in Seoul.

Starship Entertainment announced on Nov 20 that 'IVE WORLD TOUR <SHOW WHAT I AM> ENCORE' will take place Jan 29–31, 2027 at KSPO DOME in Seoul Olympic Park, the same venue where the tour began. Along the way, IVE played Tokyo Dome and Kyocera Dome Osaka, and expanded their North American run to 8 cities.

📌 Source: Starship Entertainment (via Korean media)
